name: Moses Building The Tabernacle
overview: Scripture reveals that God directly instructed Moses to build the Tabernacle according to a specific pattern shown to him on the mountain, emphasizing precise obedience to divine design (Exodus 25:1, 25:40). Moses faithfully gathered the Israelites to carry out these commands, ensuring the Tabernacle was constructed as the Lord had commanded (Exodus 35:1). The Tabernacle served as a tangible shadow and example of heavenly realities, pointing forward to Christ, who is the perfect High Priest serving in a greater, not man-made, sanctuary (Acts 7:44; Hebrews 8:5; Hebrews 9:11). This underscores the Tabernacle's role as a divinely ordained foreshadowing of Christ's redemptive work.
